answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in plume, thus the distribution is public, and ledge lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a cedar header, so 4492 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Bonded capital sits idle for 3 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
